title: State Variation Note: Start of Death Claim Interest on Deferred Fixed Annuities
content:
Compliance note on the date from which death claim interest runs on Ashgrove Deferred Fixed Annuities death claims.

## Rule

- Where the contract was issued in one of **CA, NY or NJ**, the death claim interest runs from the owner's date of death.
- Where it was issued elsewhere and this contract's death claim was received more than **10** days after the valuation date, it runs from the date the death claim was received.
- Otherwise it runs from the valuation date.

The interest runs to the payment date. The state of issue is the one on the contract record; the owner's date of death and the date the death claim was received are those recorded on the death claim; the valuation date is the date the valuation interest closed on.

## Matrix

| State of issue | Death claim received, relative to the valuation date | Interest runs from |
|---|---|---|
| CA, NY or NJ | Any | The owner's date of death |
| Any other state | More than 10 days after | The date the death claim was received |
| Any other state | 10 days after or fewer | The valuation date |

## Worked cases (hypothetical: owner died 3 January; valuation date 20 January)

| State of issue | Death claim received | Interest runs from |
|---|---|---|
| NY | 10 March | 3 January |
| OH | 10 March (49 days after the valuation date) | 10 March |
| OH | 30 January (10 days after) | 20 January |
| OH | 31 January (11 days after) | 31 January |
